messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] us-west1-primary GPU pool capacity alarm. queue_depth=11234, p95_latency=3.2s, autoscaler_errors=ScaleLimitExceeded (5m window). triggering incident channel.

emily: i'm oncall, seeing the page. pulling metrics now. anyone already in the runbook?

nina: noticed spikes ~11:10 UTC from a customer campaign. autoscaler hit per-region GPU quota and failed to scale beyond 16 nodes. queuing started at ~11:12.

emily: ok. runbook step1: confirm scope and impact. emily: user-facing: increased 5xxs and APM traces show backlog on inference queue. support dashboards show ~8% error-rate for high-traffic tenants.

tom: p95 for text-gen routes up to 3.2s, tail much worse. some requests timing out at 15s and garnishing 503s.

leo: checking routing: spillover policy tried to route to eu-west1 as configured, but got variant-mismatch errors on a subset (model v1.2 vs v1.1). those failed and requeued back to us-west1, worsening queue.

emily: that's bad. set routing to skip model-variant mismatch and fall back to compatible variant only? who can change?

nina: i can patch routing policy to prefer compatible model variants and avoid requeueing. prepping a patch.

ops-bot: deploy request by nina: patch/route-avoid-mismatch -> staging (status: queued)

danielle: alert from Enterprise A reporting latency spikes in their dashboard, started 11:15. reported impact: slow search/autocomplete in prod.

maya: support: sending status to affected customers now. minimal wording, ETA unknown.

emily: runbook step2: try manual scale up if autoscaler failing. can someone try to manually add a warm pool?

nina: trying manual spin up of additional GPU instances in us-west1-primary. running internal command:

```
redwoodctl pool allocate --region us-west1 --pool primary --gpu-type a100 --count 4 --reason "incident emergency"
```

ops-bot: allocation request accepted, provisioning started (est ~6m).

leo: in parallel i'll disable requeue on variant mismatch and enable geo-urgent-steer to eu-west1 warm-standby pools only. patching router config now.

```
# router flag change
router.set_policy("spillover", {"allow_requeue_on_mismatch": false, "prefer_warm_standby": true})
```

ops-bot: router config change staged, applying to edge routers (canary to 5% first).

emily: note: autoscaler logs show ScaleLimitExceeded coming from cloud quota limits. we've got ticket with infra but manual allocation will buy time. also open a quota request asap.

tom: manual pool came up +4 GPUs, queue dropped 40% in next 90s. p95 improved to 1.1s for routes that made it through. good.

danielle: customer comms updated: "We are mitigating a capacity issue; some requests may see elevated latency. Engineering actively scaling and routing to fallback regions."

maya: received reply from Enterprise A: appreciates quick update, asks if failover will impact model parity. noted.

leo: note about model parity: when routing cross-region we sometimes use quantized or v1.1 to preserve latency. we've flagged impacted tenant to prefer consistency vs latency.

emily: next steps: (1) confirm autoscaler quota request filed (2) keep additional manual nodes until quota and autoscaler back to stable (3) revert router canary after telemetry stable (4) postmortem. assigning owners.

nina: filed quota ticket with cloud (INC-98721), linked to infra. request includes temporary burst allowance.

ops-bot: monitoring: queue_depth now 6,832 -> trending down. p95 latency 1.0s -> stable.

tom: small regression: some older clients hit variant mismatch still—about 0.8% requests returning 400 due to schema differences. switching those tenants to explicit model pinning per their pref.

danielle: pulling list of affected tenants for comms. will coordinate targeted messages.

emily: i'm handing off oncall to tom in 20m. tom, you're the responder for remediation & followups. i'll stay available for escalation.

tom: ack, taking over. i'll keep the channel updated every 5m until stable.

leo: followup technical actions: create a tolerant routing path that will convert /compat requests to compatible variant instead of requeueing; add integration test to detect variant-mismatch loops. filing ticket ENG-3112.

emily: final note: create a short-run postmortem including timeline, root cause (quota + requeue loop), mitigations (manual pool, router policy change, quota request), and actions (increase quota, warm-standby sizing, router safeguards).

maya: updating public status page: "Degraded performance in US-West region — Mitigation in progress".

incident-bot: incident severity set to Sev2 by emily. paging paused.

ops-bot: final telemetry snapshot: queue_depth=2,101, p95=0.9s, 5xx_rate=1.2%.

tom: closing loop: stable for 10m, keeping manual nodes for 4h until autoscaler + quota confirmed. will file full postmortem. :white_check_mark:

nina: thanks everyone. filing runbook tweaks and the variant test to prevent requeue loops.

danielle: comms sent to affected customers with follow-up note to be shared in postmortem.

maya: support channel cleared, will reopen if customers report regressions.

incident-bot: incident ticket INC-294567 created and linked.
